segments.name: Trading of proprietary digital assets and derivative contracts
segments.description: Provides cryptocurrency derivative solutions, liquidity and proprietary trading for institutional clients and high-net-worth individuals, plus SFC-licensed securities advising and asset management in Hong Kong.
segments.evidence: The Company has identified one operating segment: ● trading of proprietary digital assets and derivative contracts.

revenueModel.text: The company earns income from executing cryptocurrency-related transactions with OTC clients, proprietary trading gains, interest and service fees, and fees from SFC-licensed securities advising and asset management services.
revenueModel.evidence: We initiated digital asset services in December 2021 and generate income primarily from the execution of cryptocurrency-related transactions, which includes the provision of derivative solutions to over-the-counter ("OTC") clients and our proprietary trading activities.

changes.text: In 2023, the company discontinued and disposed of its mainland China supply chain management platform business.
changes.evidence: Upon the completion of the Disposition on March 31, 2023, we discontinued and ceased the Mainland China Business and terminated the VIE structure.

dropped: change not grounded: In 2025, the company divested its 40% equity interest in the NextGen Fund.
